description: This Python source file defines classes and methods for generating and validating CloudZero Resource Names (CZRN) specifically for LiteLLM resources. It includes functionality for creating CZRN identifiers from resource data and components, normalizing parts of the identifiers, and extracting components from existing CZRN strings.

classes.name: CZEntityType
classes.description: An enumeration defining entity types for CloudZero Resources, currently only 'team'.

classes.name: CZRNGenerator
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate, validate, normalize, and extract components from CloudZero Resource Names (CZRN).

methods.name: str create_from_litellm_data(self, row: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a CZRN string from a dictionary containing LiteLLM resource data, primarily mapping provider, team ID, and model to a CZRN.

methods.name: str create_from_components( self, service_type: str, provider: str, region: str, owner_account_id: str, resource_type: str, cloud_local_id: str )
methods.description: Builds a CZRN string from individual normalized components such as service type, provider, region, owner account ID, resource type, and local ID.

methods.name: bool is_valid(self, czrn: str)
methods.description: Validates whether a given CZRN string conforms to the expected regex pattern.

methods.name: tuple[str,str,str,str,str,str] extract_components(self, czrn: str)
methods.description: Extracts the six components of a CZRN string into a tuple.

methods.name: str _normalize_provider(self, provider: str)
methods.description: Normalizes a provider name to a standard form based on known mappings or defaults.

methods.name: str _normalize_component(self, component: str, allow_uppercase: bool = False)
methods.description: Normalizes individual CZRN components to meet format requirements, replacing invalid characters and handling casing.
